stage1.impression: A clean, well-ordered colour-range lineup on white paper: eight tinted acrylic horn speakers on an arc, backlit, each throwing a grey shadow tipped with a coloured cast. The idea reads, but it reads as a well-made CG product line-up rather than a photograph. The paper is a featureless white void with blotchy mottle, the colour casts are thin slivers at the shadow tips, the cabinets are dark and muddy against the paper, and the smoked-black unit is a black hole.

blocking_9: The coloured light through the acrylic must be the dominant event on the floor: saturated, luminous casts covering a large share of each shadow, not a thin tip on a grey shadow
The set must have depth: a visible tonal fall-off from floor to cove to wall (at least 15 levels top to floor) instead of a uniform 238-240 white field
Paper must read as real paper at scale: fine even tooth, no low-frequency blotches
Every cabinet must read as glowing tinted acrylic with its colour clear at a glance, including the smoked black and water-clear units, with edge definition on every silhouette
No dead black inside the horns or the black cabinet; detail held above lum 10 except at true contact

defects.what: Wall and cove are a flat white field (lum 237.5-239.7, range 2.2): no gradient, no horizon, no depth; reads as a CG void
Paper shows low-frequency blotchy mottle that reads as procedural noise, not paper tooth
Colour casts confined to a small band at each shadow tip; main shadow bodies are neutral grey (lum ~150, RGB neutral), so the 'colour through acrylic' idea is weak
Red cast washed out (R222 G163 B165): fill and overhead silks lift the shadow and desaturate the cast
Red cabinet reads muddy and dark (lum median 59) instead of glowing red acrylic
Smoked-black cabinet is a near-black mass (lum median 25), detail and silhouette lost
Horn throats are a crushed black blob (26 % of pixels crushed in the red horn); same in all eight horns
Bottom fifth of the frame is empty white floor that carries no information
Busy internal structure (ribs, batts, ports) visible through every cabinet; reads cluttered at hero size (product, out of scope)

changes.problem: The ambient wash lifts every shadow so the coloured casts are pale and the shadows read as flat grey; the picture's one idea is underplayed.

evidence.measured: red cast R222 G163 B165 (weak); shadow bodies lum 149-151, neutral, only 0.63 of the paper's 238

changes.expected: Shadow bodies drop to lum ~110-125 and the casts become deeper, more saturated colour against them; the floor reads as lit by one sun.

changes.problem: The sun at 30 deg throws short shadows, so the coloured transmission lands in a thin strip and the horns' colour patches are small.

evidence.measured: yellow cast only ~10 px tall at half size; casts occupy a small fraction of each shadow

change.to: 18 deg (keep azimuth straight behind, 1.5 deg, 5200 K; raise strength to 22 W/m2 so the casts stay luminous)

changes.expected: Shadows and casts roughly 1.6x longer toward the lens; the coloured patches become broad bands that fill more of the floor in front of each speaker and use the empty bottom of the frame.

changes.problem: The wall and cove are uniformly lit, giving a white void with no depth or horizon.

evidence.measured: top-left lum 237.5-239.7, range 2.2; wall band 140-200 lum 239.5; floor 237.2: no gradient anywhere

change.from: cyc 16.0 W/m2 centred 2.5 m up, top 11.0 W/m2
change.to: cyc 9 W/m2 centred 1.2 m up (so the wall falls off upward), top 8 W/m2

changes.expected: A soft vertical gradient: top of frame ~215-225, cove ~232, floor in front ~236; the cove line becomes faintly legible and the title sits on a slightly toned field.

changes.problem: The cabinets read dark and muddy against the white paper; the black unit is a hole.

evidence.measured: black cabinet lum median 25, p5 5.5; red cabinet lum median 59

changes.expected: Each cabinet's tint reads brighter and cleaner, and the smoked and clear units gain edge highlights that define their silhouettes.

changes.problem: The paper's mottle reads as blotchy procedural noise, not paper.

evidence.measured: visible low-frequency blotches in 3x crop; lum range 3.0 dominated by blotch scale rather than fine tooth

changes.expected: An even, fine paper surface with no blotches; detail only at grazing light near the shadows.

changes.problem: The horn throats are a crushed black blob on every unit.

evidence.measured: 26 % of pixels crushed, p5 0.0 in the red horn

changes.expected: The compression driver reads as a metal-and-dark object with a rim highlight rather than a hole.

changes.problem: Colour casts and cabinet tints lack punch after the neutral view transform.

evidence.measured: blue cast R157 G180 B208, low saturation

changes.expected: Casts read as clear, saturated colour; paper stays neutral (R-B within 5).

changes.problem: The bottom fifth of the frame is empty floor while the outermost shadows nearly touch the frame edges.

evidence.measured: lum 234-239 throughout, nothing in it; red shadow reaches x~15, black shadow x~1265

change.from: extra shift -0.015 frame heights; centres 0.85 m
change.to: extra shift +0.03 frame heights (after c2 the longer casts fill the lower frame); centres 0.80 m apart for side margin

changes.expected: Lineup and casts balanced in the frame with breathing room at both sides and the top fifth still clear for the title.

out_of_scope.request: Simplify or hide the internal ribs, batts and port tubes seen through the cabinets
out_of_scope.why: They are the speaker's parts; the clutter they add at hero size is a product decision, not a set or light fix

out_of_scope.request: Make the cabinet's opaque lining pass light so the whole shadow is coloured
out_of_scope.why: The batts are part of the fixed product; only the clear parts and the horn transmit
